verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a developer-facing financial API platform like Paxos, so the axis applies. The evidence covers REST, FIX and WebSocket APIs, the Dashboard, llms.txt files and AI assistance built into the docs, but never mentions an official command-line tool. Those AI-readable docs and APIs are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
